summary: Bally's Corporation subsidiary Bally's New York Operating Company, LLC entered a senior secured term loan agreement on September 4, 2026 with WhiteHawk Capital Partners as agent, comprising $400 million closing-date commitments plus $160 million delayed draw. Proceeds fund pre-construction costs for the Bally's Bronx development and general corporate purposes. Loans mature 18 months after initial funding at Term SOFR plus 8.50% and are secured by substantially all Bally's New York Loan Party assets. This is a routine credit-facility financing, not a special situation. Watch regulatory approval timing and drawdown conditions.
